question: Should `tool-progress` be approved as a distinct public plugin-SDK classification alongside the existing fast-mode progress kind, rather than represented by the broader `isStatusNotice` contract?
rationale: Both shapes are technically viable, but the choice establishes durable semantics for external plugins and sibling channels; source inspection cannot determine the intended public API boundary.

options.title: Approve distinct tool progress
options.body: Keep the generic progress kind, define its distinction from status notices, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate into status notices
options.body: Remove the new public symbols and represent transient tool chrome with the established status-notice contract while keeping reaction mapping Slack-owned.

recommendation.title: Approve distinct tool progress
recommendation.body: Keep the generic progress kind, define its distinction from status notices, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Git blame provides the most direct history connection to the existing reply status contract that this decision must distinguish from.
